sloka: अशोभत मुखम् तस्य जृंभमाणस्य धीमतः ।अंबरीष उपमम् दीप्तम् विधूम इव पावकः ॥४-६७-७॥
transliteration: aśobhata mukham tasya jṛṁbhamāṇasya dhīmataḥ ।aṁbarīṣa upamam dīptam vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ॥4-67-7॥

translations.english: On expansion, wise Hanuman's face was bright, glowing like a burning oven and shining like smokeless fire.
